set.body: Umbrella for the four-phase plan in docs/plans/2026-08-15-vision-alignment.md, synthesized from four independent code audits (API surface, execution layer, capability contract, docs/gates). Finding: the self-form spine is sound, but four of five headline claims are currently contradicted by the code — query-first is a measured 3.5-3.9x regression for rdm/rsa with an O(q^4) eager query matrix; generalization identity rides on free-text partition labels while the same estimand gets route-dependent plan ids; refusals are unclassed strings and the learned-metric admission hard-codes metric_status='fixed'; rectangular forms are internal-only, coupling is a disconnected small-node pipeline, and conservation holds for 'total' only while searchlights() defaults to the non-conservative normalization. Phases: 1 Integrity, 2 Query-first for real, 3 One calculus/one vocabulary, 4 Evidence+docs. Phase 4 largely delegates to the existing novelty epic bd-01M02MSCEDS68A4P4XFWHG0NPG and its Gate 1-5 children. Acceptance: all four phase beads closed with tests/benchmarks/receipts per the plan file.
set.title: Epic: Vision alignment — make the code implement the closure calculus
